Sam (People Ops): Quick check before I publish the Travel & Expense quick FAQ: per-diem rules, receipts threshold, booking rules, and spouse/guest policy. Need final sign-off.
Rina (Sales): For client-facing trips we sometimes need nicer hotels. Any firm caps?
Maya (Finance): Guideline caps: $250/night standard; $350/night for high-cost metros (NYC, SF, LON). Client-facing roles can request up to $300/night in most metros with manager pre-approval. Anything above requires pre-approval recorded in TravelPerk. No retroactive approvals.
Owen (Eng): Meals: do we need receipts if we take per-diem?
Maya (Finance): You must choose one: either submit meal receipts for that day OR elect the daily per-diem. Domestic per-diem (meals only) = $75/day. International per-diem varies by country 1 submit country code and system applies rate.
Rina (Sales): What about tiny things like coffee or a taxi under $25?
Maya (Finance): Receipts required for single transactions >= $25. Under $25, put it as "misc" in the expense form with a short note; no receipt required unless merchant can provide one.
Owen (Eng): Missing receipts procedure? I lost a taxi receipt in Berlin.
Maya (Finance): If a receipt is unavailable: for amounts <= $50, include a brief written explanation in the expense form. For amounts > $50, upload a Missing Receipt Affidavit and attach manager approval. Finance may follow up.
Sam (People Ops): Spouse/guest expenses? We've had asks for partner dinners.
Maya (Finance): We do not reimburse spouse/guest travel or meals unless pre-approved for a documented business reason (e.g., hosting a client). Pre-approval requires manager + Finance sign-off; only the business portion is reimbursable and must be itemized.
Rina (Sales): Conference fees and optional social events?
Maya (Finance): Conference registration = reimbursable with receipt and business purpose. Optional social events are not reimbursable unless explicitly pre-approved. If a conference includes mandatory networking meals, attach the event schedule.
Owen (Eng): Currency conversions for out-of-pocket in EUR/INR?
Maya (Finance): For corporate-card charges we use the bank's FX rate. For reimbursements, use the T&E tools conversion rate (or XE on the transaction date) and include the conversion proof if > $500 USD equivalent.
ExpenseBot: Reminder: submit all expenses within 60 days of trip end date. Late submissions may be declined. Link: https://redwood.example/internal/travel-policy
Sam (People Ops): Final checklist I'm going to add to the one-pager 1 please ack: 1) Book via TravelPerk when available; 2) Use corporate card for flights/hotels when possible; 3) Manager pre-approval for >cap or special cases; 4) Receipts for >= $25; 5) Per-diem $75 domestic or actual receipts; 6) Missing receipt affidavit > $50; 7) No spouse/guest reimbursement without pre-approval; 8) Submit within 60 days.
Rina (Sales): Ack. Add note: if trip <12 hours and no overnight, meals are not eligible for per-diem.
Owen (Eng): Ack. Also add: if you choose per-diem you cannot also submit receipts for that same day.
Maya (Finance): Will add an appendix with country-specific per-diem and a sample JSON snippet for automated uploads. Finance reviews exceptions within 5 business days.
Sam (People Ops): Thanks all 1 publishing this afternoon and will post a short FAQ thread with examples. :memo:
